headline: Reworks a batch of fixes the real-data test loop caught as broken or incomplete: your morning brief now actually reconciles the follow-ups you sent straight from Gmail (instead of just claiming it did), stops telling you to redo work you've already done, and shows every prospect that looks like a client — and your project people-lists drop stray vendor/demo contacts. All of it surfaces automatically on your next brief and weekly cleanup; nothing for you to do.
